description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git format-patch' command, specifically focusing on patch numbering and subject line formatting options. It includes setup commands, test cases for different formats and configurations, and assertions to verify output correctness.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, runs a series of shell commands, and asserts their success.

methods.name: test_num_no_numbered
methods.description: Counts the number of patches with no numbering in the output file.

methods.name: test_single_no_numbered
methods.description: Verifies there is exactly one patch without numbering in the given output file.

methods.name: test_no_numbered
methods.description: Verifies there are exactly two patches without numbering in the output file.

methods.name: test_single_cover_letter_numbered
methods.description: Checks that the output file contains patches with cover letter numbering.

methods.name: test_single_numbered
methods.description: Checks that the output file contains a single numbered patch.

methods.name: test_numbered
methods.description: Checks that the output file contains multiple patches with numbering.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
